question_text: The angles of elevation of the top of a tower from two points at a distance of 4 m and 9 m from the base of the tower and in the same straight line with it are complementary. Prove that the height of the tower is 6 m.

answer_text: Therefore, the height of the tower is 6 m.

steps.description: Let AQ be the tower and R, S be the points 4m and 9m away from the base of the tower respectively.
Since the angles are complementary, if one angle is θ, the other will be 90 - θ.
Using trigonometric ratios in triangles AQR and AQS, derive the height of the tower.

final_answer: Thus, the height of the tower is 6 m.
